gates.name: Stock policy reproduction
gates.pass_condition: Reproduce the frozen checkpoint before any custom scene is interpreted.

gates.name: Primitive capability
gates.pass_condition: Every action exposed in the current core product scope has a one-sided 95% reliability lower bound of at least 0.90 in its declared context.
gates.current: ACT 100/100; T01 drawer-joint opening 97/100. This does not certify that the target became visible; that stricter requirement is FP3. ROTATE is excluded and remains 0/30.

gates.name: Prompt-conditioned belief
gates.pass_condition: An RGB-only model represents where prompt-relevant uncertainty lies and passes scene-disjoint prompt-swap calibration tests without target-pose, segmentation, or simulator-state inputs.
gates.current: The upstream frozen-prefix belief passes three T01 prompt/state conditions at 97/100, 100/100, and 99/100. It is not scene-disjoint and currently covers only OBSERVED versus MANIPULATION_ONLY.

gates.name: Calibrated action-effect model
gates.pass_condition: For every enabled information action, predict the post-action observable effect from (prompt, observation, action), with class-conditional conformal coverage at least 0.90 on disjoint scenes.
gates.current: Paired RGB now exists. Strict visual effects are REVEALED 57/60 (lower 0.876) and EMPTY 56/60 (lower 0.854). Critics v1-v3 fail development; v3 reaches 20/21 coverage but only 15/21 singleton-correct. The frozen audit has not been opened. An OPEN_AND_OBSERVE composite and oracle-free proprioceptive return stage are implemented; static coverage is 60/60 and perturbed-pose return is 30/30, but the full composite remains unrun.

gates.name: Expected-risk optimizer
gates.pass_condition: Select ACT, information acquisition, or NOT_FOUND by minimizing expected prompt-conditioned task risk. Decision costs come from measured action cost and reliability or a preregistered sensitivity analysis; no tuned confidence-routing threshold is permitted.
gates.current: Finite-horizon Bayes-risk planning is implemented without a confidence threshold and routes 296/300 T01 counterfactuals for the target- observability endpoint. A product-belief temporal monitor and SAFE_STOP branch now exist, but their proposition calibration, task losses, and live sequence evidence are not frozen. Final-task ACT risk is not ready: open-drawer retrieval is 0/5 and visible cream-cheese ACT is unmeasured.

gates.name: Oracle-free closed loop
gates.pass_condition: Audit the complete controller and show zero reads of simulator joints, segmentation, hidden target poses, or task predicates for routing, stopping, belief updates, and NOT_FOUND.
gates.current: T01 routing is oracle-free and the closed-loop runner is implemented, but it is intentionally blocked by the failed outcome/effect gate.

gates.name: Prompt-alignment counterfactuals
gates.pass_condition: On the same scene with different prompts, and the same prompt with different resolvable causes, the correct-decision reliability lower bound is at least 0.90 and the method beats prompt-blind fixed rules.
gates.current: The frozen T01 audit includes identical RGB with swapped prompts and the same prompt with closed/open state, and beats three prompt-blind rules. It does not yet cover different resolvable causes or held-out scenes.

gates.name: Multi-action information acquisition
gates.pass_condition: Reliably acquire the required information in at least three disjoint action families, with a one-sided 95% lower bound of at least 0.90 for each family.
gates.current: Drawer opening is 97/100 by joint motion, but strict camera-visible information is 57/60 and does not pass the 0.90 lower-bound requirement; the return-to-observe sub-controller alone is 30/30 diagnostic-only. Full OPEN_AND_OBSERVE and move/rotate/other-occluder families are not certified.

gates.name: Final task completion
gates.pass_condition: After information acquisition, complete the original final task with a one-sided 95% reliability lower bound of at least 0.90 and a positive paired improvement over the monolithic VLA.
gates.current: OPEN_CONTAINER -> ACT is 0/5; direct open-drawer retrieval is 0/5.

gates.name: Abstention and exhaustion
gates.pass_condition: Correctly return NOT_FOUND only after calibrated search exhaustion, with at least 0.90 lower-bound reliability on both target-present and target-absent cases.
gates.current: NOT_FOUND has no certified executor or outcome calibration.

gates.name: Scene and policy generalization
gates.pass_condition: Pass object-, clutter-, occlusion-, and container-held-out tests and reproduce the decision benefit with a second frozen policy.
gates.current: Only the T01 pi0.5 reveal path is certified.

gates.name: Release and reproducibility
gates.pass_condition: One-command evaluation, pinned environment, frozen calibration hashes, complete failure demos, automated gate report, and clean GPU shutdown.
gates.current: Core artifacts and scripts exist; the complete final-product runner does not.
